data.action: 停驻在花丛树荫下的轮椅上，膝盖覆着薄毯翻看诗集
data.description: 【蕾缪安 · 花园小憩】开满纯白圣花的大教堂后花园树荫下，蕾缪安的轮椅静静停在长椅旁，膝上覆着一条格子羊绒毯，正优雅地翻看着一本拉特兰古典诗集。察觉到你的注视，她合上书页浅笑——「偶尔像这样什么也不做，只与你在这安静的花香中虚度时光，也是一种神圣的恩赐呢。」
data.promptProse: Lemuen rests in her wheelchair beside the weathered church-garden bench, tracing a line in a leather-bound poetry collection over the blanket on her knees. Sage cable-knit cardigan, champagne camisole and flowing trousers retain the recovery outfit. She looks up serenely in the medium view, white flowers bordering the shaded corner. Fresh morning light filters through leaves onto pages and her face, with moving foliage shadows across the blanket and nearby blooms.
data.title: 蕾缪安 · 花园小憩
